## IBM Watson Customer Churn Data Set

The `wu_churn` data set is a collection of IBM Watson customer data collected in September 2018. The data contains a factor variable of whether or not the customer has churned, and other related information about the customer.

```{r}
# Install and load the dataset
# install.packages("modeldata")
# library(modeldata)
data(wa_churn)
head(wa_churn, 10)
?wa_churn
```

## Report Outcome

The goal of this report is to use the `wu_churn` data set to compare the performance between two models trained to predict whether a customer will churn based on their observed characteristics. Ultimately, this will show quantitative methods of scoring model performance and derive metrics for proving the strongest predictor choice.
